description: Load the user's periods with sheet status and open the entry form directly, defaulting to today in the subject timezone.
Bound the date field to the editable periods and disable days on locked or uncovered sheets (click, typed, and Today paths).
Resolve or create the sheet from the entry's work date only at Save and recheck its actual editability.
Name the sheet the chosen day lands on under the date field and follow every date change.
Move the default to the nearest editable day with an explanation when today cannot take time; block with actionable feedback when no period exists or none accept time.
Initialize dates and time defaults inside the selected period using the subject timezone, preserving valid context defaults.
Pass the selected sheet and its actual period together to the bounded entry form while preserving work-item context.
Resolve existing entries through their saved sheet and actual period without offering a period transfer.
Reject saves on locked target or original sheets in the write transaction while retaining existing permission and period guards.
Propagate save failures so the dialog retains entered values; close and refresh the caller once on success.
Accessible, theme-aware, translated date-first entry on shared launcher surfaces, including the shared date field's per-day rule.
Show save rejections (locked sheet, no period, server lock) with their own reason while keeping typed values.
